_comment: SBEG 461 Lab 1 robot models. Planar n-R chains moving in the vertical x-y plane, gravity along -y, all joint axes along z, zero configuration = all links along +x. L = link lengths [m], m = link masses [kg], r = distance of the link centre of mass from its own joint along the link [m], I = link moment of inertia about its centre of mass, about z [kg m^2]. All values are ILLUSTRATIVE (not taken from a specific product or person).

mr_2r_point.description: MR Figure 8.1 / Eq. 8.9: point masses at the link ends, L1 = L2 = m1 = m2 = 1 (as in MR Fig. 8.3)

arm_exo_2r.description: Sagittal-plane shoulder-flexion / elbow-flexion arm + exoskeleton (upper arm + cuff, forearm + hand + cuff), illustrative values

eod_3r.description: Vertical-plane shoulder / elbow / wrist-pitch arm of a tracked EOD robot; link 3 = wrist + gripper + 2 kg suspect package, illustrative values
